q: How does a PET recycler count the transport of bottle bales it buys?
title: PET recyclers: inbound bale transport
short: If you pay for the transport, it is Scope 3, category 4. Multiply tonnes of bales by distance and by a freight intensity, or use the trucker's fuel. If the bale seller delivers and charges one price, the transport sits in their figure, not a separate line.
audience: PET bottle recyclers and flake producers buying baled post-consumer bottles

p: Tonnes delivered and kilometres per trip, from weighbridge slips and trip sheets.
Tonne-km x a GLEC or national intensity for the truck size, or litres of diesel x 2.68.
Inbound transport is part of the burden recycled flakes carry under the recycled-content method, so include it when a buyer asks for a figure per kg.
